The 2027 World Athletics Championships will welcome the sport’s biggest stars back to Beijing, 12 years on from the Chinese capital’s successful staging of athletics’ flagship event and almost two decades on from the Beijing Olympic Games. China will also host next year’s World Athletics Indoor Championships, in Nanjing. tool.excerpt: Nairobi Launches Bid to Host 2029 World Athletics Championships ePaper Home Live Blog Breaking News Top Headlines Cities NE News Sentinel Media Sports Education Jobs Home Live Blog Breaking News Top Headlines Cities NE News Sentinel Media Sports Education Jobs Sports Nairobi Launches Bid to Host 2029 World Athletics Championships Nairobi bids to host 2029 World Athletics Championships, aiming to become the first African city to stage the global event. Sentinel Digital Desk Published on : 11 Aug 2026, 4:59 am Copied Follow Us NEW DELHI: Nairobi has formally submitted its bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships, seeking to become the first African city to stage the flagship event. The Kenyan capital faces competition from London, Rome and Munich for the hosting rights. The Kenya government has committed full backing for the bid, including the infrastructure, security and organisational support required to stage the event. Kenya has previously hosted the 2007 World Cross Country Championships in Mombasa, the World Under-18 Championships in Nairobi in 2017 and the World Under-20 Championships in the capital in 2021. Nairobi also staged the African Athletics Championships in 2010.
